verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own scenario modeling and versioned forecasts (aleph-docs-3) and headcount planning backed by live HRIS/ATS data (aleph-docs-4), which partly covers assumption-driven planning, including hiring. It never explicitly describes driver-based models or configurable growth and price-point assumptions; the actual model logic appears to live in users' synced Excel/Sheets workbooks (aleph-docs-1, aleph-docs-2). Missing for 10: explicit driver-based modeling capability, documented growth and price-point assumption inputs, evidence that assumptions replace hard-coded rows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
